artifact_uri: examples/rollout_select.py (spread logged per step); smoke run PnPCounterToSink K=4, 1 episode
summary: Candidate action diversity at rollout time is ~9.5 deg mean (min 0.006, max 30 deg), measured as 1-cos to the candidate mean over K=4 samples per replan step across a full PnPCounterToSink episode with GR00T N1.6. This is 15x smaller than the 150 deg spread measured earlier on a SYNTHETIC single-frame probe input. In-distribution, with real state and video history, the flow-matching sampler is confident. Selection among K samples of the same observation therefore has almost nothing to choose between.
